_doc: Citations (UPDATE 10 s6 item 9, DECISIONS T-162; gravelight/world/citations.gd): the achievements. Earned once per profile (ProfileSave.profile.citations[id] = true), shown as a HUD toast (GLBus.bonus_awarded kind `citation`) and listed on the Service Record. `event`: wing_walk (FirstHints watcher: the local player clipped or on the wing), spring_tide (GLBus.spring_tide, when the signal exists, then the round ends), orbit (MoonLowG.orbit_count >= target), special_survived (a special round ends on `map`), boss_killed (`enemy` id, GLBus.enemy_killed), quest (`quest` id, GLBus.quest_completed). `guard_data`: a res:// file that must exist for the citation to be listed or earned (Totenhafen's egg until it lands); `guard_signal`: a GLBus signal that must exist. Every quest in data/gravelight/quests has a citation (test_citations).

citations.name: Took the Wing Walk
citations.desc: Step out onto the Kranich's wing in flight.

citations.name: Survived a Spring Tide
citations.desc: Live through a spring tide at Totenhafen.

citations.name: Sent to Orbit
citations.desc: Throw 5 of them off the Moon with the Lodestone.

citations.name: Dust Walker
citations.desc: Live through the dust storm at Groom Lake.

citations.name: Raid Survivor
citations.desc: Live through the air raid at Werk Thalbach.

citations.name: Beat the Hafenwaechter
citations.desc: Put the Hafenwaechter, the pens' night watchman, down at Totenhafen.

citations.name: Letzte Fahrt
citations.desc: Sail the U-1047 out of the pen at Totenhafen.
